prompt: Use the provided painting only as the reference for the brush hand: the same painter, the same confident sumi line, the same smooth wet washes, the same warm rice paper. Paint a new, quiet still life in that hand: a calligraphy brush resting across the rim of a dark stone inkstone, and a small round water dropper standing beside it, seen from a low three-quarter view. Objects only. Paint it the way a master of freehand ink wash would, in the boneless manner, with a large soft brush loaded with diluted ink on damp paper, in very few strokes. Every shape is a smooth, flat, wet wash with a soft bleeding edge, like ink flooding damp paper, and the tone inside each wash is even and liquid. The inkstone is one bold, solid, deep sumi-black mass laid down in two or three broad wet strokes, an even black in its well where the ink pools, with a paler smooth grey wash on its rim. The brush lies diagonally across the stone, its dark wet pointed tip resting in the well and its handle rising to the upper right. The handle is plain bamboo, drawn with two long, confident, thin ink lines and a pale smooth wash between them, and it ends in a clean square cut. Around the ferrule, where the hair meets the handle, there is a tiny band of gold leaf, the only colour in the picture. The water dropper is a small round pot made of one smooth turn of pale grey wash with a darker mouth. Under the objects there is only a loose, pale, wet shadow wash that fades away into the paper. There is no sheet of paper, no mat, no cloth, no table edge and no drawn outline under them. The ink is smooth everywhere: no grain, no speckle, no stippling, no dabs, no dots, no pencil, no hatching, no charcoal or pastel texture, no rough dry-brush scumble. The group is centred and fills about two thirds of the frame, with wide clear empty paper on every side. Its edges dissolve softly into the paper and nothing is cut off. Plain empty warm rice paper ground, evenly lit. No people, no hands, no writing, no characters, no text, no seal, no signature, no border, no background scene. Ink greys and that one touch of gold only. Nothing red.
